Store method (`func (s *Store) ListMemos` delegating to `s.driver.ListMemos`) — `store/memo.go`
Dialect implementation (`func (d *DB) ListMemos` building the WHERE clause and SQL) — `store/db/sqlite/memo.go` (parallel implementations exist in `store/db/postgres/memo.go` and `store/db/mysql/memo.go`)

The driver interface that connects the store to the dialects is declared at `store/driver.go:30`, and generated client/server stubs live in `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts` and `proto/gen/api/v1/memo_service_grpc.pb.go` / `proto/gen/api/v1/apiv1connect/memo_service.connect.go`.
